notes.title: The legendary classic Supaplex series comes to Linux on Steam
notes.notes:
Supaplex, a game originally released back in 1991 now has multiple modern versions available on Steam and it seems the developers have now added Linux support years later.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/01/the-legendary-classic-supaplex-series-comes-to-linux-on-steam
